Settings.SupportMessage: Support the author and the module on Boosty:

Bastardhall.Name: Bastardhall sheet
Bastardhall.Hint: Adds the Bastardhall campaign sheet to the Actor Directory, including Soulhearts, collections, research, phantoms, climate, mementos, and area unlocking.

DamageSave.Name: First save with damage
DamageSave.Hint: When rolling damage from an ability, adds the first Fortitude, Reflex, or Will save from its description to the damage message.

TempHealing.Name: Enable thealing and t+healing
TempHealing.Hint: Enables temporary-HP behavior and custom button labels for thealing and t+healing. When disabled, both work as ordinary healing.

Regeneration.Name: Regeneration
Regeneration.Hint: Automates disabling regeneration when matching damage is received.

LightBlindness.Name: Light Blindness
LightBlindness.Hint: Automatically applies dazzled and blinded according to the token's illumination.

BloodMagic.Name: Bloodline
BloodMagic.Hint: Shows a Blood Magic block on the action and lets you link the needed spells to it.

CreatureAttack.Name: Creature Attack
CreatureAttack.Hint: Adds creature strike controls with level-based attack and damage quality values.

DamageAdjustments.Name: Weak., Res., and Imm.
DamageAdjustments.Hint: Builds weakness, resistance, and immunity rules from selected types and level-based formulas.

CriticalSpecialization.Name: Critical Specialization
CriticalSpecialization.Hint: Builds a CriticalSpecialization rule with level and weapon filters.

Enhancement.Name: Enhancement
Enhancement.Hint: Adds conditional extra text to action descriptions through ItemAlteration based on creature level and/or an action slug.

DegreeOfSuccess.Name: Degree of Success
DegreeOfSuccess.Hint: Automatically applies configured target and source consequences for PF2E roll outcomes.

Affliction.Name: Afflictions
Affliction.Hint: Configures and automates poisons on actions, including stages, saves, and rerolls.

ShoulderToShoulder.Name: Shoulder to Shoulder
ShoulderToShoulder.Hint: Automatically enables an action's toggleable rules while enough allies are adjacent.
ShoulderToShoulder.AutomationEnabled: Automation enabled — click to leave this toggle under manual control
ShoulderToShoulder.AutomationLocked: Manual control — click to resume automation

MountedCombat.Name: Mounted Combat
MountedCombat.Hint: Adds mount selection, linked movement, the system mounted effect, a shared footprint, and lesser cover.

FamiliarOwner.Name: Familiar Owner
FamiliarOwner.Hint: Adds familiar selection and automatically makes the action owner an owner of the selected familiar.

ActorLanguages.Name: Languages
ActorLanguages.Hint: Adds an Action extra feature for showing selected languages on the character sheet.

ActorSenses.Name: Senses
ActorSenses.Hint: Adds an Action extra feature for showing selected senses on the character sheet.

SpellSet.Name: Spell Set
SpellSet.Hint: Adds a level-scaled spellcasting set to the Action extra features.

Coven.Name: Coven
Coven.Hint: Adds coven spells and the Support Coven action to coven members.

Alchemy.Name: Alchemy
Alchemy.Hint: Adds level-scaled advanced alchemy formulas to the Action extra features.

Appearances.Name: Appearances
Appearances.Hint: Adds configurable NPC sheet and token appearances.

ActorTraits.Name: Traits
ActorTraits.Hint: Adds an Action extra feature that grants selected actor traits.

SceneEye.Name: Enable Scene Eye
SceneEye.Hint: Adds a quick-view eye button next to scene links in chat and journal entries (GM only).

Thumb.Name: Enable Scene Thumb
Thumb.Hint: Adds a custom thumbnail field to the scene configuration form.
Thumb.Label: Thumb Image
Thumb.FieldHint: Custom thumbnail used for this scene in the navigation and directory.

TexturePreset.Name: Scene texture preset
TexturePreset.Hint: Selects a coordinated texture set for this scene only. Clients request only the set used by the active scene.

FloorTextures.Name: Enable floor texture editing
FloorTextures.Hint: Adds tools for filling closed rooms and drawing floor boundaries. Existing textured floors remain visible regardless of this setting.
FloorTextures.OverlayFloorOnly: Overlay floors can only be placed over an existing floor.
FloorTextures.AlreadyFilled: This area already has a floor.
FloorTextures.OpenRoom: No closed room was found here.
FloorTextures.NeedThreePoints: A floor needs at least three points.
FloorTextures.BaseFloorCreated: The base floor covers the whole scene.
FloorTextures.CurrentLevelHint: This level and uncovered lower floors are visible.
FloorTextures.FloorLevelHint: New floors and the change-level tool use this value.

Choices.CrowdPoorLaborersMerchantsMiddleClass: Poor people + Laborers + Merchants + Middle class
Choices.CrowdPoorLaborersArtisansMiddleClass: Poor people + Laborers + Artisans + Middle class
Choices.CrowdPoorMerchantsArtisansMiddleClass: Poor people + Merchants + Artisans + Middle class

Choices.CrowdPoorMerchantsMiddleClassAristocrats: Poor people + Merchants + Middle class + Aristocrats

Choices.CrowdPoorArtisansMiddleClassAristocrats: Poor people + Artisans + Middle class + Aristocrats

ObstructingForest.Name: Obstructing Forest
ObstructingForest.Hint: Automatically grants lesser, standard, or greater cover at 15, 30, or 60 feet of combined deciduous, pine, and mixed forest between creatures. Open gaps are not counted.

WallTextures.Name: Enable wall texture editing
WallTextures.Hint: Adds wall or border texture controls to every wall, plus dedicated window textures. Existing textured walls remain visible regardless of this setting.
WallTextures.ModeFieldHint: Choose a wall texture or a border texture. Wall restrictions are not changed.
WallTextures.BorderFieldHint: Draws the selected border texture along the wall without changing its restrictions.
WallTextures.FieldHint: Draws the selected texture along this wall segment.

SceneAssets.Name: Enable scene assets
SceneAssets.Hint: Adds a categorized library for placing scalable and rotatable map assets, including linked light sources.
SceneAssets.Help: Move: 0.1 grid · Ctrl+wheel: size · Shift+wheel: rotate 15° · R: rotate · F: flip · Delete: remove selection
SceneAssets.NoTilesSelected: Select one or more tiles first.
SceneAssets.DollhouseGothicCastleClosedSquare: Closed square gothic castle dollhouse (0.3 cell)

HolderChoices.Crystal: Side wall torch — with Everlight Crystal
HolderChoices.CursedCrystal: Side wall torch — with Evercursed Crystal ⚠

SceneDecorator.Name: Enable area decorator
SceneDecorator.Hint: Fills rooms and polygons with semantic scenery presets.
SceneDecorator.Title: Area decorator
SceneDecorator.Help: Choose an area, inspect the preview, then apply.
SceneDecorator.Empty: Nothing could be placed in this area.
SceneDecorator.NothingToUndo: There is no recent fill to undo.
SceneDecorator.NoPresets: No presets — create one with the gear button
SceneDecorator.PresetIncomplete: Enter a name and add at least one object.
SceneDecorator.LevelChanged: The map level changed. Select the area again.

DoorTexturePresets.Name: Enable quick door texture presets
DoorTexturePresets.Hint: Adds a thumbnail picker for Foundry's built-in door textures to the wall configuration.
DoorTexturePresets.Label: Door preset
DoorTexturePresets.Empty: Foundry door presets were not found.

WindowTextures.FieldHint: Draws the selected texture along this window segment.

SpellAtWill.Name: Enable spell tags
SpellAtWill.Hint: Adds At Will, Constant, and Self toggles to the PF2E spell sheet.

DefaultStyle.Name: Default journal style
DefaultStyle.Hint: Sets which of this module's journal sheets is used as the default sheet for PF2E journal entries.

Read.Name: Enable read sections
Read.Hint: Activates .read sections in journals so the marked block can be posted to chat from the sheet.

TSFormatMenu.Name: Enable TS Format menu
TSFormatMenu.Hint: Shows the TS submenu in the journal editor Format menu and adds the TS Journal Autoformat action.

ImageSections.Name: Enable image sections
ImageSections.Hint: Adds a Style field to the journal image insert dialog. If filled, the image is inserted as a section with that CSS class.

Notifications.OnlyGM: Only the GM can open this game.
Notifications.BastardhallDisabled: The Bastardhall sheet is disabled in the module settings.
Notifications.DevilsPinChoiceRequired: Choose a skill and a legal target first.
Notifications.DevilsPinNoPlayers: Add at least one participant before starting.
Notifications.DevilsPinNoConfirmedChoices: There are no confirmed throws to resolve.
Notifications.DevilsPinAllChoicesRequired: All participants must choose and confirm before the round can resolve.
Notifications.DevilsPinRepeatResolvedTarget: One of the throws repeats the previous round's resolved target.
Notifications.KubokerNoPlayers: Add at least one participant before the deal.

HuntPrey.AutomationEnabled: Automation enabled — click to leave this toggle under manual control
HuntPrey.AutomationLocked: Manual control — click to resume automation

TempHP.TemporaryTitle: Apply the result as temporary Hit Points
TempHP.OverflowTitle: Restore Hit Points and apply the excess as temporary Hit Points
TempHP.Applied: Applied {amount} points to the selected token(s).
TempHP.NoChange: The selected token(s) already have at least {amount} temporary Hit Points.

Horror.Name: Horror Mode
Horror.Hint: Enables Dread, expanded d20 critical ranges and Scares. While enabled, every character has at least Dread 1.
Horror.ScareTableHint: Opens a standard Foundry d20 RollTable. Edit all 20 results, their text and ranges. Existing edits are preserved.
Horror.EffectDescription: Dread is a separate counter, independent of Frightened and its penalties. While Horror Mode is enabled, minimum 1 and maximum 5. Natural d20 ≤ Dread is a critical failure; an enemy attack d20 ≥ 21 − target Dread is a critical success.
Horror.Error: Horror Mode error. See the console.
Horror.NightmareDescription: {name}: an attempt to raise Dread above 5 immediately triggers a personal shock nightmare. Dread remains 5. The GM determines its content and consequences.
Horror.ScareFailed: Failure — the environment causes a Scare.
Horror.GMResolves: The GM chooses targets, duration, damage and saves and applies the consequences.
Horror.Fled: {name} spends all actions fleeing: Dread reduced by 2 (minimum 1).
Horror.TenMinutes: This activity can finish only once per ten minutes.
Horror.GMOnly: Only the GM can toggle Horror Mode.
Horror.Disabled: Horror Mode disabled. Dread values are preserved and the rules are inactive.
Horror.SelectCharacter: You need a character you own on this scene.
Horror.GMRequired: An active GM is required to process Dread.
Horror.ActionRules: Dread is a separate value, independent of Frightened. Will and Scare DC = 1 + total Dread of the active Party, including members absent from this scene. Will success reduces Dread by 1, critical success by 2. Prevent Panic is used in combat for yourself or an ally. Suppress Dread is used outside combat for yourself and takes ten minutes of world time.
Horror.FleeHint: Use Flee only after spending all actions fleeing. Movement and action expenditure are confirmed manually. Choose the acting character as the target.

Scares.1: Open flames in the zone go out.
Scares.2: Doors slam shut and the exit locks.
Scares.3: A fresh corpse moves and rises.
Scares.5: Paranoia makes allies look like monsters.
Scares.6: A hero sees an enemy in an ally’s place and tries to strike them.
Scares.7: Walls move inward, narrowing the passage.
Scares.8: A swarm of insects erupts from the cracks.
Scares.9: A mirror shows a dead reflection and shatters.
Scares.10: An icy scream drowns out voices and commands.
Scares.11: The ceiling collapses over an area chosen by the GM.
Scares.12: A shadow detaches and pursues its owner.
Scares.13: Hands reach from beneath the floor and grab at ankles.
Scares.15: A familiar passage vanishes; the return path leads elsewhere.
Scares.16: Equipment appears alive and struggles out of its owner’s hands.
Scares.17: A dead ally calls a hero toward danger.
Scares.18: Black slime makes the floor slippery.
Scares.19: An unseen presence pursues the most frightened hero.
Scares.20: The zone manifests a shared nightmare: the GM combines two distinct Scares.

Horror.PartyRequired: Select an active PF2e Party and add its members. The DC uses the Party roster.
Horror.PartyDC: DC = 1 + total Dread of Party members: {dc}.
